output.root_cause: A recent rollout for productcatalogservice introduced an invalid container image, leading to repeated image pull failures and preventing new pods from becoming ready. This has resulted in the productcatalogservice being unavailable or unstable.
output.action_taken: Undo the current rollout for productcatalogservice to revert to the previous stable container image configuration. This will resolve the image pull failures and allow the service to recover.

solution.root_cause: A recent rollout for productcatalogservice introduced an invalid container image, leading to repeated image pull failures and preventing new pods from becoming ready. This has resulted in the productcatalogservice being unavailable or unstable.
solution.action_taken: Undo the current rollout for productcatalogservice to revert to the previous stable container image configuration. This will resolve the image pull failures and allow the service to recover.
